content.short: Verto is a B2B cross-border payments and FX platform for businesses trading with emerging markets.
content.description: Verto is a global B2B cross-border payments and foreign-exchange platform, founded in 2018, that helps businesses send, receive and exchange money across borders with a focus on emerging markets, particularly Africa. Through its accounts and APIs, companies hold multiple currencies, access competitive FX, and make and collect payments in more than 190 countries, tackling the friction and high costs of trading with hard-to-reach markets. Verto serves startups, SMEs and large corporates that need reliable settlement into currencies traditional banks handle slowly or expensively, and it has moved toward stablecoin-based rails to make international transfers faster. By combining multi-currency accounts, FX and treasury tools, it works as a cross-border money engine for global business.
